source_text.body:
Get hands-free recipes while cooking
A commenter uses Grok through AirPods while cooking so they don't have to look at their phone for recipes.
·
Nov 15, 2026
Done with
GB
Grok Bot
What they did
A commenter said they and their wife use AirPods to talk to Grok while cooking, so they can get recipe help without looking at their phones. In practice, they use it hands-free to ask how to cook dishes and to get ingredient substitutions when something is missing; another commenter specifically called the phone-call mode convenient.
How it went
The reported result was that they can cook pretty much anything without checking a phone for recipes anymore. The thread does not give setup steps, timings, or any examples of where it failed.
Worth knowing
The useful catch is that this depends on using Grok by voice through AirPods, with the phone-call feature mentioned as the convenient part.
Try it yourself
with
Grok Bot
Copy prompt
I'm cooking [dish] right now and have my hands full, so talk me through the recipe by voice, one step at a time. Wait for me to say 'next' before moving on, and answer questions like substitutions or timing as they come up. I have [ingredients on hand] and need it ready in [time], and the job is done when the dish is plated.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/GrokBot/comments/1xrjfsw/roundup_some_of_the_coolest_grok_bot_use_cases
